about: The falsifier: the second head's word read from the lock before this one. verify is a live family, judged when read and never kept, yet the fold read its latest stored attestation; at a take the batch's lines have landed and that attestation rests on the previous epoch, so every verify badge and every second/verdict rendered stale against leaves that say agrees.
